children: Hong Kong shipping firm's H1 2026 revenue fell 13% yr/yr due to fewer operating vessels
Net profit attributable to shareholders fell to HK$30.8 mln from KH$53.8 mln
Company did not recommend interim dividend for H1 2026
Jinhui Holdings did not provide specific financial guidance for the current or future periods
FEWER VESSELS - Revenue decline was mainly due to reduced number of operating vessels after disposal of eight Supramaxes in prior year
HIGHER FREIGHT RATES - Average daily time charter equivalent rate improved about 30% yr/yr, offsetting some impact from reduced fleet
GEOPOLITICAL DISRUPTIONS - Arabian Gulf conflict and supply chain constraints caused operational inefficiencies in shipping sector
The stock recently traded at 0 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 0 three months ago
